description: This file defines the LanguageHelper class responsible for managing language strings and translations within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for reading language strings from YAML files, retrieving and managing language and group IDs, inserting translations, and creating or deleting test language packs.

classes.name: LanguageHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing language strings, language data, and translations, including reading language data from YAML files, inserting translations into a database, and handling language packs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LanguageHelper with a database connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the database connection associated with this helper.

methods.name: readLangStrings
methods.description: Reads language strings from a YAML file and associates them with a group ID.

methods.name: getGroupIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a language group by its name, caching the result.

methods.name: deleteLangStringByUnitId
methods.description: Deletes language strings based on a unit ID, optionally filtered by a group ID.

methods.name: insertTranslation
methods.description: Inserts a translation for a language string in a specific language.

methods.name: getLanguageIdByLangCode
methods.description: Returns the language ID associated with a language code.

methods.name: updateLanguageStatusByLangCode
methods.description: Enables or disables a language based on its code, and marks whether it is added.

methods.name: createTestLanguagePack
methods.description: Creates a test language pack by enabling a special language code and populating it with sample translations.

methods.name: deleteTestLanguagePack
methods.description: Removes the test language pack and disables the test language.
